description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Tables without a primary key: XE1 (unique index AA_UN on N, then non-unique index ZZ_I on ID), XE2 (unique ZZ_UN on N, then non-unique AA_I on ID); both columns have 8 distinct values. Then XI as in round 1 with SELECT ID, s FROM XI WHERE N BETWEEN 5 AND 6 and ... WHERE N BETWEEN 5 AND 6 AND s <> 'zz' (a selective range with and without a residual), and XJ (ID primary key, an index on N) with ... WHERE N >= 3 AND N >= 3 (the same conjunct twice). Dynasets of SELECT ID, s FROM XE1 and FROM XE2, then the statements above. Asks whether a unique index is preferred to an equally distinct non-unique one or the name decides, and whether any residual conjunct gives storage order. Rows (ID, N, G) inserted (5, 3, 1), (2, 7, 2), (8, 1, 1), (1, 6, 2), (7, 4, 1), (3, 8, 2), (6, 2, 1), (4, 5, 2), s 'r1' to 'r8' in insertion order; indexes made before the rows.
